cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(hyle_d5_native_fragment_consumer LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT D5_ROUTE MATCHES "^(cpu|apple|vulkan)$")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "D5_ROUTE must be cpu, apple, or vulkan")
endif()
find_package(Hyle 0.1.0 EXACT REQUIRED COMPONENTS core compute graph simd)
get_filename_component(_hyle_fixture_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${D5_GGML_SOURCE}/src/ggml.c" OR
   NOT EXISTS "${D5_GTEST_SOURCE}/googletest/src/gtest-all.cc")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Provide the pinned D5 host oracle sources")
endif()
block()
  set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
  set(GGML_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
  set(GGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
  set(GGML_CPU OFF)
  set(GGML_CUDA OFF)
  set(GGML_VULKAN OFF)
  set(GGML_METAL OFF)
  set(GGML_NATIVE OFF)
  set(GGML_OPENMP OFF)
  add_subdirectory("${D5_GGML_SOURCE}" fixture-ggml EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endblock()
set(gtest_force_shared_crt ON)
set(BUILD_GMOCK OFF)
set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF)
add_subdirectory("${D5_GTEST_SOURCE}" fixture-gtest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(d5_nanobench STATIC "${_hyle_fixture_root}/bench/nanobench_impl.cc")
target_include_directories(d5_nanobench SYSTEM PUBLIC "${_hyle_fixture_root}/third_party/nanobench")
target_link_libraries(d5_nanobench PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
set(_target "hyle_graph_route_${D5_ROUTE}_d5_bench")
add_executable(${_target} "${_hyle_fixture_root}/bench/graph_route_${D5_ROUTE}/d5_fragment_bench.cc")
target_compile_features(${_target} PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
target_compile_options(${_target} PRIVATE
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8;/W4;/WX>
  $<$<NOT:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Werror>)
target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE hyle::graph hyle::compute hyle::simd
  d5_nanobench GTest::gtest ggml-base)
hyle_stage_runtime_dependencies(${_target})
add_executable(hyle_perf_control_bench "${_hyle_fixture_root}/bench/integration/perf_control_bench.cc")
target_compile_features(hyle_perf_control_bench PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
target_compile_definitions(hyle_perf_control_bench PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_link_libraries(hyle_perf_control_bench PRIVATE hyle::core d5_nanobench)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME d5_native_fragment_verify COMMAND ${_target})
set_tests_properties(d5_native_fragment_verify PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 600
  ENVIRONMENT "HYLE_BENCH_VERIFY_ONLY=1")
